description: This Java class `JwtSecretKey` is responsible for configuring and providing a SecretKey bean used for JWT signing, utilizing a secret key from `JwtConfig`. It is part of the security configuration in a Spring application.

classes.name: JwtSecretKey
classes.description: Spring configuration class for generating and providing a JWT SecretKey bean.

methods.name: secretKey
methods.description: Creates and returns a SecretKey for JWT signing, based on the secret key string from JwtConfig.
